When people do not have the confidence to
perform tasks well, they are likely to (A)[create /
remove] obstacles to success. This type of behavior is
referred to as "self-handicapping." Self-handicapping
enables people to make excuses for their poor
performances. These excuses prevent the poor result
from (B)[lowering / raising] their self-esteem. This
might work in the short term. However, be careful!
It could lead to repeated (C)[failures / successes] in
certain tasks that you are not confident in doing.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로바르게 연결된 것은?

(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 이러한 유형의 행동을 “자기불구화‘라고 부르며, 자기불구 화는 사람들이 좋지 않은 성과에 대해 변명할 수 있게 한다는 내용이 뒤에 이어지므로, 사람들은 과제를 잘 수행할 자신감이 없을 때, 성공에 방해가 되는 장애물을 ’만들‘ 가능성이 높다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 create(만들다)가 알맞다. (B) 이러한 변명들은 좋지 않은 결과가 자존감을 ’낮추는‘ 것을 막아준다는 흐름이 되어야 자연스럽다. 따라서 lowering(낮추 는 것)이 알맞다. (C) 조심하라는 경고 내용 뒤에 이어지므로, 이것은 자신감이 없는 특정 과제에서 반복적인 ’실패‘로 이어질 수 있다는 흐름 이 되어야 한다. 따라서 failures(실패들)가 알맞다.

sometimes ⓐface difficult moments. It is not
unusual because everyone ⓑgoes through difficult
times. Even though you feel disappointed with your
choices or behaviors, don't let ⓒyou feel down.
ⓓMost important thing is figuring out your own
way to overcome your negative feelings. It will
make your school life ⓔvery more enjoyable. If you
feel worried, remember that you are not alone. You
have friends, teachers, and me. Good luck in this
ⓕexciting new chapter of your life.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 알맞지 않은 것은?

When people do not have the confidence to
ⓐperform tasks well, they are likely to create
obstacles to success. This type of behavior is
referred to as "self-handicapping." Self-handicapping
enables people to make ⓑexcuses for their poor
performances. These excuses prevent the poor result
from lowering their self-esteem. This might work in
the short ⓒterm. However, be careful! It could lead
to repeated failures in certain tasks that you are
not confident in doing.
If you are self-handicapping, it might be because
you consider the results more important than the
process. Focusing more on the process than the
outcome may ease the ⓓpressure to perform well.
Accordingly, you may feel more encouraged to try
to do the ⓔchallenging tasks. This can eventually
stop your self-handicapping.
choices: ⓐperform: to do something, especially somethingdifficult or useful
ⓑexcuse: an explanation offered in defence ofsome fault or offensive behaviour oras a reason for not fulfilling anobligation, etc.
ⓒterm: a word or expression with a particularmeaning, especially one that is used fora specific subject or type of language
ⓓpressure: a way of working or living thatcausesyoualotofanxiety,especially because you feel youhave too many things to do
ⓔchallenging: difficult in an interesting or enjoyableway
solution: ⓒ term은 ‘기간’이라는 뜻으로 쓰였으나, ‘a word or expression with a particular meaning, especially one that is used for a specific subject or type of language(특정한 의미를 가진 단어 나 표현, 특히 특정 주제나 언어 유형에 사용되는 단어나 표 현)’는 term의 여러 뜻 가운데 하나인 ‘용어’에 대한 영영풀이 이므로 알맞지 않다. 본문에서 쓰인 뜻에 맞게 ‘a fixed period of time during which someone does something or something happens(누군가가 무언가를 하거나 어떤 일이 일어 나는 고정된 기간)’와 같은 설명으로 고쳐야 한다. 천재(조수경) 1과

body:
Hello, first-year students. I'm your school counselor,
Hannah Kim. How is your new school life? You may
have experienced a situation (A)[where / which]
things didn't go as you expected at school. Have
you ever wondered why this happens? Let's take a
look at the following two cases.
The first case is about a student (B)[naming /
named] Hajun. On the first day of school, Hajun's
homeroom teacher introduced several school clubs.
At that time, Hajun ⓐ___________________. He thought
that any indoor club would be okay since he was
not an outdoor person. Can you guess what happened
on the day of choice? He joined the soccer club.
What made him (C)[choose / to choose] soccer?
Well, a few days before submitting his application,
he heard that the soccer club was so popular that
half of his classmates were applying for it. This
made him think that the soccer club was something
special. With this in mind, he signed up for the
soccer club just because others (D)[were / did].
However, after he had joined the club, he realized
that soccer was not for him. In the end, he
regretted his decision.

윗글의 괄호 (A)~(D)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

(A)
(B)
(C)
(D)
solution: (A) a situation(상황)을 선행사로 수식하는 완전한 절(things ~ school)이 이어지므로 관계부사 where가 알맞다. (B) ‘하준이라고 이름 지어진 학생’이라는 의미로, 수식하는 a student와 수동의 관계를 이루므로 과거분사 named가 알맞다. (C) 사역동사 made의 목적격보어이므로, 동사원형 choose가 알맞다. (D) 앞에 나온 동사를 반복하지 않기 위해 대동사를 사용할 수 있으며 일반동사의 대동사는 do이므로, 앞에 나온 signed up for the soccer club을 받는 대동사로 did가 알맞다.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

ⓐ
ⓑ             ⓒ
solution: ⓐ 완전한 절(it might be different from your friends')이 이어 지므로 접속사 Although(~할지라도)가 알맞다. Despite는 전치 사이므로 뒤에 명사(구)가 이어진다. ⓑ cause(초래하다)는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 to follow가 알맞다. ⓒ 주어 This phenomenon(이 현상)이 “밴드 왜건 현상”이라고 ‘불리는’ 대상이므로 과거분사 called와 함께 수동태를 이루는 is가 알맞다.

body:
Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?"
ⓐWhen the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron
tower was very different from all the other
architecture in Paris, where was mainly made of
stone. Many local people disliked the tower and
complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris.
ⓑNevertheless, as the locals became familiar with
the tower due to exposure, they became more and
more fond of it, referred to it as the Tower of
Love. This effect, also called the "Mere Exposure
Effect,” is found with people, too. Psychologist
Robert Zajonc and his colleagues showed university
students pictures of several faces. Some pictures
were shown 25 times while others were shown only
once or twice. Then, the students were shown a
picture and asked to express how much they liked
that person. The students liked the people they had
seen more often better than those they had seen
less frequently. This shows that the more we are
exposed to something, the more favorably we view
it.

다음 글을 아래와 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 지문에서 찾아 빈칸에 맞게 각 각 쓰시오. (필요시 변형할 것)

Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?" When the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron tower was very different from all the other architecture in Paris, which was mainly made of stone. Many local people disliked the tower and complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris. Nevertheless, as the locals became familiar with the tower due to exposure, they became more and more fond of it, referring to it as the Tower of Love. This effect, also called the "Mere Exposure Effect,” is found with people, too. Psychologist Robert Zajonc and his colleagues showed university students pictures of several faces. Some pictures were shown 25 times while others were shown only once or twice. Then, the students were shown a picture and asked to express how much they liked that person. The students liked the people they had seen more often better than those they had seen less frequently. This shows that the more we are exposed to something, the more favorably we view it. Derived from the Parisians' change in feelings for the Eiffel Tower, the Eiffel Tower Effect is also termed (A)__________ __________ __________ __________, a phenomenon in which the more (B)__________ we encounter something, the more (C)__________ we think of it; which was also demonstrated in a study by psychologist Robert Zajonc, where students preferred the people in the pictures they saw more (B)__________. 천재(조수경) 1과
answer: (A) the Mere Exposure Effect (B) frequently[often] (C) favorably (B) frequently[often]

When people do not have the confidence to
perform tasks well, they are likely to create
obstacles to success. This type of behavior is
referred to as "self-handicapping." Self-handicapping
enables people to make excuses for their poor
performances. These excuses prevent the poor result
from lowering their self-esteem. This might work in
the short term. However, be careful! It could lead
to repeated failures in certain tasks that you are
not confident in doing.
If you are self-handicapping, it might be because
you consider the results more important than the
process. Focusing more on the process than the
outcome may ease the pressure to perform well.
Accordingly, you may feel more encouraged to try
to do the challenging tasks. This can eventually
stop your self-handicapping.
choices: People can excuse themselves for their bad results by self-handicapping.
People are inclined to create barriers to success when they are not assured of good results.
The reason you are self-handicapping could be that you value the result over the process.
You can continue to do well in jobs that you are not confident about by means of self-handicapping.
If the strain of carrying out tasks well is reduced, you may feel more inspired to try to do difficult ones.

Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?"
When the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron tower
was very different from all the other architecture in
Paris, which was mainly made of stone. Many local
people disliked the tower and complained that it
would ruin the beauty of Paris. Nevertheless, as the
locals became familiar with the tower due to
exposure, they became more and more fond of it,
referring to it as the Tower of Love. This effect,
also called the "Mere Exposure Effect,” is found with
people, too. Psychologist Robert Zajonc and his
colleagues showed university students pictures of
several faces. Some pictures were shown 25 times
while others were shown only once or twice. Then,
the students were shown a picture and asked to
express how much they liked that person. The
students liked the people they had seen more often
better than those they had seen less frequently.
This shows that the more we are exposed to
something, ___________________________________________.
choices: the more we want to change it
the more curious we are about it
the more favorable we consider it
the more we regard it as worthless
the more indifferent we become to it
solution: 정답은 ③ 이다. (해설 없음)

solution: (A) 자신의 피부 색조에 완벽하게 맞는 색깔인 퍼스널 컬러를 확 인함으로써 어떤 색의 의상이 자신에게 어울리는지 알 수 있다는 내용이 이어지므로, 매력적인 외모를 연출하는 데 있어서 착용하 는 색깔이 중요하다는 흐름으로 important(중요한)가 알맞다. People wear tuxedos when a formal dress code is
(A)[required / unnecessary], like for the opera,
dinner parties, or awards shows. The tuxedo likely
got its name from Tuxedo Park, one of the first
gated communities in New York. In the late 19th
century, men usually wore jackets with long tails
that reached their knees on formal occasions. One
evening, a man showed up with a short black
jacket without tails in Tuxedo Park. The male guests
who stayed there were (B)[irritated / fascinated] by
the new jacket and started to wear the same style.
Later, more people asked their tailors to make them
a jacket "like the one worn in Tuxedo Park." At
first, this style of jacket was considered less
(C)[formal / informal] than one with long tails. As
more and more men wore the shorter style, it
eventually replaced the longer version. Now men's
formal wear is the tuxedo. Isn't it ironic that the
tuxedo was not originally considered very formal,
but now it is the most formal clothing men wear?
(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 뒤에 오페라, 저녁 파티, 시상식과 같은 격식을 갖춘 행사의 구체적 인 예시가 이어지고 있고, 글의 후반에서 이제 남자들의 격식을 갖춘 옷은 턱시도라고 했으므로, 이와 같이 공식적인 복장 규정이 요구될 때 턱시도를 입는다는 흐름으로 required(요구되는, 필요한)가 알맞다. (B) 같은 스타일을 입기 시작했다는 내용이 뒤에 이어지므로, Tuxedo Park에 한 남자가 꼬리가 없는 짧은 검정색 재킷을 입 고 나타났다는 내용에 이어 그곳에 있던 남자 손님들이 그 새로 운 재킷에 매료되었다는 흐름으로 fascinated(매료된)가 알맞다. (C) 앞에 언급된 this style of jacket(이 스타일의 재킷)은 꼬리가 짧 은 재킷 스타일을 말하며, 점점 더 많은 남자들이 더 짧은 스타일 을 입으면서 긴 버전을 대체하게 되었고 이제 남자들의 격식을 갖 춘 옷은 턱시도라는 설명이 뒤에 이어지고 있으며, 원래는 그렇게 격식을 갖춘 것으로 여겨지지 않았지만 이제는 가장 격식을 갖춘 남성복이라는 것이 역설적이라는 내용으로 마무리하고 있으므로, 처음에 이 스타일의 재킷이 긴 꼬리가 달린 재킷보다 덜 격식 있는 것으로 여겨졌다는 흐름으로 less 뒤에 formal(격식 있는)이 알맞다. 천재(조수경) 2과

Whether they are loose fit or slim fit, most of you
have at least one pair of blue jeans. They were
named "jeans" ⓐ______________ they were made of
jean, a sort of tough cotton cloth. The word jean is
a modification of Gênes, the French name of the
Italian city of Genoa. In the 17th and 18th
centuries, Genoa was a major center for trade.
Sailing merchants from Genoa traded their goods
throughout Europe, particularly in England and
France. One of the items that made Genoa famous
was a strong cotton cloth, ideally suited to making
tough work clothes. The cloth was most likely
colored blue. French was widely spoken in Europe
at that time, ⓑ______________ the cloth was called
"bleu de Gênes" (the blue of Genoa). This is how
the pants made with "bleu de Gênes" became
known as blue jeans in English.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

You have probably owned a pair of sneakers for
everyday activities or sports. They are a type of
athletic shoe designed specifically to be worn for
physical activities and sports. So, why are they
called sneakers? The name "sneakers" is (A)[altered
to / derived from] the term "to sneak up." Due to
the fact that sneakers' soles are mostly made of
rubber, they make little noise when people walk.
This allows people who are wearing them to
(B)[pick up on / creep up on] others. Before rubber,
leather was used for the sole of shoes. Traditional
leather shoes make a lot of noise, and it is
(C)[easier / harder] to hear the person wearing
them. However, with sneakers, you can quietly
sneak up on your friends and surprise them.
(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 앞에 ‘그렇다면, 그것은 왜 스니커즈라고 불릴까요?(So, why are they called sneakers?)’라는 질문이 화두로 제시되었으며, 뒤에 ‘스니커즈’라고 불리게 된 배경과 관련해 그것을 신고 다 른 사람들에게 몰래 다가갈 수 있다는 내용의 구체적 설명이 이어지므로, ‘스니커즈’라는 이름이 ‘to sneak up(몰래 다가가 다)’이라는 용어에서 유래되었다는 흐름으로 derived from(~에 서 유래된)이 알맞다. (B) 앞에서 스니커즈의 밑창은 고무로 만들어져 있어 사람들이 신고 걸을 때 소리가 거의 나지 않는다고 했으므로, 이것이 그 것을 신은 사람들이 다른 사람들에게 조용히 들키지 않고 다 가갈 수 있게 한다는 흐름으로 creep up on(~에게 몰래 다가 가다)이 알맞다. (C) 전통적인 가죽 신발은 소리가 많이 난다고 했으므로, 그에 대한 결과로 그것을 신은 사람의 소리를 듣기가 더 쉽다는 흐 름으로 easier(더 쉬운)가 알맞다. 천재(조수경) 2과

everyday activities or sports. They are a type of

what] the staple food in Nigeria was a plant called
cassava. Unfortunately, cassava was defenseless
against viral and bacterial diseases, so it did not
yield much crop. (B)[Knowing / Knew] this, he
decided to develop stronger cassava varieties with
higher yields. However, Dr. Hahn faced a problem:
there was not much information available about
cassava. Cassava (C)[was / has] rarely studied or

matters worse, he had never seen or eaten cassava

While studying African cassava, Dr. Hahn found
out that the Europeans who colonized Brazil had
first brought cassava into Africa. He immediately
flew to Brazil to study the (A)[original / modified]
cassava. There, he learned about it and went back
to Nigeria with Brazilian cassava seeds. Then, Dr.
Hahn traveled to every corner of Nigeria and
collected different types of (B)[local / foreign]
cassava to see if they were good at fighting
diseases, but they weren't. Fortunately, he found a
plant that was similar to cassava but resistant to
diseases. He started crossing this plant with the
Brazilian cassava. After five years of hard work, Dr.
Hahn finally (C)[failed / succeeded] in developing
new varieties of cassava. They yielded much more
than the local ones and could survive diseases.

solution: (A) 아프리카 카사바를 연구하던 한 박사가 브라질을 식민지로 만들었던 유럽인들이 처음으로 카사바를 아프리카로 가지고 왔다는 것을 알게 되었다는 내용 뒤에 이어지므로 그가 원조 카사바를 연구하기 위해 즉시 브라질로 날아갔다는 흐름이 자 연스럽다. 따라서 original(원조의)이 알맞다. (B) 뒤에 질병과 잘 싸우는지 알아보기 위해서였다는 내용이 목적으로 이어지며, 그것들은 그렇지 않았다(질병과 잘 싸우지 않았다)는 것과 다행히도 한 박사가 카사바와 비슷하지만 질병 에 강한 식물을 발견해 그것을 브라질 카사바와 이종 교배했 다는 내용이 이어지므로, 한 박사가 나이지리아의 구석구석을 다니며 다양한 현지의 카사바를 모아 그것들을 살펴보았다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 local(현지의)이 알맞다. (C) 그것들, 즉 새로운 품종의 카사바는 현지 것들보다 훨씬 더 많은 양을 생산했고, 질병에서 살아남을 수 있었다는 내용 이 뒤에 이어지므로, 한 박사는 마침내 새로운 품종의 카사바 를 개발하는 데 성공했다는 흐름이 되어야 한다. 따라서 succeeded(성공했다)가 알맞다. 천재(조수경) 3과

Another obstacle Dr. Hahn faced (A)[was / to be]
distributing the new varieties. Local farmers would
not listen to a foreigner. To overcome this problem,
Dr. Hahn visited markets, churches, and schools and
gave out the new varieties to Nigerian people for
free. He went from one house to the next to let
farmers know the superiority of these new varieties.
Sometimes he planted them in the middle of the
cassava field without telling the farmers. His
colleagues were concerned that the farmers might
be angry (B)[found / to find] different cassava in
their fields. However, Dr. Hahn insisted that the
farmers would think that it was a gift from God. He
was right. The farmers soon realized the superiority
of the new varieties, and more and more farmers
started to cultivate them. Thanks to the new
cassava, fewer people were starving. In fact, they
could even make more money by selling the
remaining cassava. Eventually, Nigeria became the
country that (C)[produced / was produced] the
greatest amount of cassava in the world. In 1983,
the Yoruba, a major tribe of Nigeria, honored Dr.
Hahn as a chief with the title “Seriki Agbe” or “the
King of Farmers.”

Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, the world’s largest,
has ⓑ[appeared / disappeared]. If swift action is
not taken, scientists estimate that most coral reefs
will be destroyed by 2050.
What causes coral reefs to die? There are various
causes, like destructive fishing techniques,
overpopulation of corals’ natural enemies, and
careless tourism. However, the leading cause is the
rise in water temperature due to global warming.
The ideal temperature range for corals to live is
20°C to 28°C. When the water temperature rises
above 30°C, coral reefs turn white and eventually
die. Another serious cause is plastic waste. Plastic
products, such as bottles and fishing lines, have
been dumped into the sea. This ⓒ[spreads /
prevents] viruses and diseases, damaging coral reefs
and their inhabitants.

ⓑ             ⓒ

Here are some simple but effective steps we can
take in order to help protect coral reefs. First, you
can avoid using beauty products containing tiny
pieces of plastic because they pollute the oceans.
Also, try not to use sunscreen made with certain
chemicals that damage corals. Second, you can
volunteer to help clean the beach. Recycling and
reducing trash is a huge help in maintaining a
clean ocean. Last but not least, make it known that
coral reefs are in danger by spreading the word to
people around you. Let people know about the
threat to coral reefs and what actions to take to
save them. This will make a big difference for the
future.

billion people rely on coral reefs for safety and
survival. When large waves generated by storms
rush toward shore, coral reefs serve as natural
barriers. The force of the waves is (A)[reduced /
strengthened] as they hit the coral reefs.
Consequently, they prevent the land on the shore
from washing away and thus (B)[destroy / protect]
towns near the sea. Moreover, reefs are a source of

chests of the sea.”

(A)

body:
As far as humans are concerned, over half a
billion people rely on coral reefs for safety and
survival. When large waves generated by storms
rush toward shore, coral reefs serve as natural
barriers. The force of the waves is reduced as they
hit the coral reefs. Consequently, they prevent the
land on the shore from washing away and thus
protect towns near the sea. Moreover, reefs are a
source of medicine, and many organisms found in
coral reefs are used to treat diseases like cancer.
This is why they are sometimes referred to as the
“medicine chests of the sea.”

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

What causes coral reefs (A)[dying / to die]? There
are various causes, like destructive fishing techniques,
overpopulation of corals’ natural enemies, and
careless tourism. However, the leading cause is the
rise in water temperature due to global warming.
The ideal temperature range for corals to live is
20°C to 28°C. When the water temperature rises
above 30°C, coral reefs turn white and eventually
die. (B)[Another / The other] serious cause is plastic
waste. Plastic products, such as bottles and fishing
lines, have been dumped into the sea. This spreads
viruses and diseases, (C)[damaging / damaged] coral
reefs and their inhabitants.
(A)                (B)
(C)
solution: (A) cause는 to부정사를 목적격보어로 취하므로 to die가 알맞다. (B) 범위가 정해지지 않은 집합에서 ‘또 다른 한 ~’은 another 로 표현하므로 Another가 알맞다. (C) 분사구문의 의미상 주어가 앞 절 내용으로 이는 ‘피해를 주 는’ 주체이며 뒤에 목적어(coral reefs and their inhabitants)가 있으므로, 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 damaging이 알맞다. 천재(조수경) 4과

A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact
that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has
forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine
plants, and numerous marine animals live there with
them. That is, sea forests are habitats for
underwater creatures and the leading contributors
to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However,
uncontrolled human actions and climate change
have threatened marine plants and the other
creatures that
live
on
them. So
the Korean
government designated May 10th every year as
“Marine Gardening Day,” the first in the world. It is
meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of
ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea
forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute
to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in
damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On
a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash
along the coast on this day. It is important to
realize that small environmental activities we do can
cause a big wave to preserve the sea.

barriers. The force of the waves is reduced as they

What causes coral reefs to die? There are various
causes, like destructive fishing techniques,
overpopulation of corals’ natural enemies, and
careless tourism. However, the leading cause is the
rise in water temperature due to global warming.
The ideal temperature range for corals to live is
20°C to 28°C. When the water temperature rises
above 30°C, coral reefs turn white and eventually
die. Another serious cause is plastic waste. Plastic
products, such as bottles and fishing lines, have
been dumped into the sea. This spreads viruses and
diseases, damaging coral reefs and their inhabitants.

take in order to help protect coral reefs. First, you
can avoid using beauty products containing tiny
pieces of plastic because they pollute the oceans.

chemicals that damage corals. Second, you can
volunteer to help clean the beach. Recycling and

coral reefs are in danger by spreading the word to
people around you. Let people know about the
threat to coral reefs and what actions to take to
save them. This will make a big difference for the
future.

취할 수 있는 몇몇 간단하지만 효과적인 조치들이 있다.
First, you can avoid using beauty products
containing tiny pieces of plastic because they
pollute the oceans. Also, try not to use sunscreen
made with certain chemicals that damage corals.
Second, you can volunteer to help clean the beach.
Recycling and reducing trash is a huge help in
maintaining a clean ocean. Last but not least, make
it known that coral reefs are in danger by
spreading the word to people around you. Let
people know (B)________________________________________
_________________________________________. This will make
a big difference for the future.

윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: how to sort household waste and recyclables
how their everyday shopping decisions impact the global economy
about your beach cleanup activities through social media platforms
about the threat to coral reefs and what actions to take to save them
about exciting career opportunities in marine biology and conservation
solution:
1. 빈칸 앞에서 주변 사람들에게 알려 산호초가 위험에 처해 있다는 사실을 널리 퍼뜨리라고 했다.
2. 따라서 사람들에게 '산호초가 처한 위협과 산호초를 구하기 위해 할 일'을 알리라는 내용이 알맞다.
3. ① 분리배출, ② 세계 경제, ③ 해변 청소 홍보, ⑤ 해양 생물학 진로는 산호초의 위험을 알리는 것과 거리가 멀다.
4. 따라서 답은 ④이다.

solution: (A) 바다 숲이 수중 생물들의 서식지이자 건강한 해양 생태계 조성의 필수 요소임을 재차 말하고 있으므로, That is(즉, 다시 말해), Namely(즉, 다시 말해)가 적절하다. (B) 바다 숲이 그 중요성에도 불구하고 파괴될 위협에 직면해 있다는 흐름이므로, However(그러나), Yet(그러나)이 적절하다. body:
Coral reefs are ⓐcrucial ecosystems that protect
both marine life and people living near the sea.
Coral reefs provide shelter to ⓑan abundance of
marine life, such as fish and underwater plants.
Because of the diversity of life found in coral reefs,
they are often called “the rainforests of the sea.”
Nearly one quarter of all known marine species
ⓒdepend on coral reefs for survival — they hide
themselves from predators, find food, reproduce,
and raise their young in coral reefs.
As far as humans are concerned, over half a
billion people rely on coral reefs for safety and
survival. When large waves generated by storms
rush toward shore, coral reefs serve as natural
barriers. The force of the waves is reduced as they
hit the coral reefs. Consequently, they prevent the
land on the shore from washing away and thus
protect towns near the sea. Moreover, reefs are a
source of medicine, and many organisms found in
coral reefs are used to ⓓtreat diseases like cancer.
This is why they are sometimes ⓔreferred to as the
“medicine chests of the sea.”

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ가 흐름상 나타내는 의미로알맞지 않은 것은?
solution: depend on ~은 ‘~에 의존하다’라는 뜻으로 쓰였으므로, ‘찾다’ 라는 뜻의 find는 흐름상 알맞지 않다. rely on 등으로 고쳐야 한다.

body:
Sustainable travel means finding a way that
tourism can (A)[be maintained / maintain] without
harming natural and cultural environments. Travelers
need to be more aware of the pollution caused by
travel and how that affects nature. ⓐ_____________,
they need to be aware of how tourism affects local
people and businesses. The concept of sustainability
has three key factors. First, the environmental factor
focuses on (B)[reduction / reducing] the negative
impact on the natural environment caused by
traveling. This includes minimizing pollution from air
travel, water use, and plastic waste, and not
disturbing wild animals. Second, the social factor is
about the impact on local people. This includes
preserving and supporting communities of local
inhabitants so that they do not suffer from tourism.
Travelers should respect local customs and traditions
and (C)[adjust / adjusting] accordingly, such as by
wearing proper clothes in religious sites. Lastly, the
economic factor is about using money to positively
contribute to the local economy. ⓑ_____________, by
booking a local tour guide or staying in local guest
houses, tourists can support local businesses.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

TYPE B. Food Lover
Do you enjoy trying delicious and exotic food?
Then, Shilin Night Market in Taipei, Taiwan is for
you! With a history of more than 100 years, it is
the largest and most famous night market in
Taiwan. It is heaven for those who want to try local
street food at an inexpensive price. The fun
atmosphere and huge selection of street food make
it (A)[popular / unpopular] with both tourists and
residents.
Here are some of our recommendations for you to
try at Shilin Night Market. If you find a long line of
people, chances are (B)[high / low] that it is for ji
pai. It is a seasoned flat piece of fried chicken,
which is as large as your face. The crispiness is out
of this world. Another popular dish is oyster omelet.
It is a mixture of eggs and potato flour, filled with
fresh oysters full of juice. Sweet sauce poured on
top adds a fantastic flavor. Wouldn’t you like
something to drink now? We recommend some
papaya milk juice. This sweet fruit juice will refresh
you and boost your energy for night shopping. You
should (C)[leave / get to] the market at around 7
to 8 p.m., when everything is set up. With many
people coming and going, the atmosphere of the
market reaches its peak.
(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 스린 야시장은 100년 넘는 역사와 다양한 길거리 음식을 제공하는 음식 애호가들을 위한 천국이므로 관광객과 현지인 들 모두에게 인기 있는 곳이라는 흐름으로, popular(인기 있는) 가 알맞다. (B) 스린 야시장에서 먹어보기를 추천하는 첫 번째 음식으로 지파이를 소개하고 있으며, 뒤에 그 바삭함이 이 세상의 것이 아닐 정도로 훌륭하다고 했으므로, 긴 줄로 서 있는 사람들을 본다면 지파이를 기다리는 줄일 가능성이 높다는 흐름으로, high(높은)가 알맞다. (C) 모든 것이 준비되는 시간이라고 뒤에 언급하고 있으므로, 오후 7시에서 8시쯤에 시장에 가보라고 조언하는 흐름으로 get to(~에 도착하다)가 알맞다.

choices: You might want to take some sunscreen.

solution: ‘Don’t forget to+동사원형‘은 상대방에게 무언가를 상기시키거나 당부, 조언을 나타내는 표현으로, 유사한 의미를 갖는 ’Remember to+동사원형(~할 것을 기억해)‘, ’Be sure to+동사원형(꼭[반드시] ~하라)‘, ’Make sure+S+V(꼭[반드시] ~하라)’, ‘You might want to+동사원형(~하고 싶을지도 몰라, ~하는 것이 좋겠어)’ 등으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. 그러나 ‘be allowed to+동사원형’은 ‘~하는 것이 허락[허용]되다, ~해도 된다’라는 뜻의 허가하는 표현이므 로 밑줄 친 (A) ‘자외선 차단제를 가져가는 것을 잊지 마.’를 ❹ ‘너는 자외선 차단제를 가져와도 돼.’로는 바꿔 쓸 수 없다.

street food at an inexpensive price. The fun
atmosphere and huge selection of street food make
it ⓐpopularly with both tourists and residents.
Here are some of our recommendations for you to
try at Shilin Night Market. If you find a long line of
people, chances are high that it is for ji pai. It is a
seasoned flat piece of fried chicken, ⓑit is as large
as your face. The crispiness is out of this world.
Another popular dish is oyster omelet. It is a
mixture of eggs and potato flour, ⓒfilling with fresh
oysters full of juice. Sweet sauce poured on top
ⓓadding a fantastic flavor. Wouldn’t you like
something to drink now? We recommend some
papaya milk juice. This sweet fruit juice will refresh
you and boost your energy for night shopping. You
should get to the market at around 7 to 8 p.m.,
when everything is set up. With many people ⓔcome
and go, the atmosphere of the market reaches its
peak.

tourism can be maintained without harming natural
and cultural environments. Travelers need to be
more aware of the pollution caused by travel and
how (A)that affects nature. (B)They also need to be
aware of how tourism affects local people and
businesses. The concept of sustainability has three
key factors. First, the environmental factor focuses
on reducing the negative impact on the natural
environment caused by traveling. This includes
minimizing pollution from air travel, water use, and
plastic waste, and not disturbing wild animals.
Second, the social factor is about the impact on
local people. This includes preserving and
supporting communities of local inhabitants so that
(C)they do not suffer from tourism. Travelers should
respect local customs and traditions and adjust
accordingly, such as by wearing proper clothes in
religious sites. Lastly, the economic factor is about
using money to positively contribute to the local
economy. For example, by booking a local tour
guide or staying in local guest houses, tourists can
support local businesses.

TYPE A. Festival Lover
If you are into spectacular festivals, how about Loi
Krathong in Sukhothai, Thailand? Visit this famous
festival of lights and join the Thai people at a
river’s edge. There, you can release floating lanterns
called krathongs while making a wish. This lets you
release all your negative energy and welcome good
fortune in the coming year. The legend says that if
the lantern remains lit until it disappears from sight,
your wish will come true.
Although Loi Krathong is held throughout Thailand,
Sukhothai is the best because it is its birthplace.
Sukhothai also holds the biggest celebration in
Thailand, which lasts for about five days. In addition
to floating lanterns, you can also enjoy beautiful
fireworks, learn folk dances, and watch spectacular
light and sound shows. We cannot emphasize
enough how beautiful the temples and monuments
surrounded by bright lights are! The festival takes
place on the day of the full moon of the 12th
month in the Thai lunar calendar. This usually
comes in November in the solar calendar. However,
since the exact date changes every year, make sure
to check before you head to Thailand.

choices: Loi Krathong in Sukhothai is renowned as aspectacular celebration of lights.
During the Loi Krathong Festival, people canrelease floating lanterns while making wishes.
Sukhothai, the birthplace of Loi Krathong, offersThailand’s largest celebration, lasting about fivedays.
At the Loi Krathong Festival, you can viewtemples and monuments illuminated with brightlights.
The Loi Krathong Festival typically takes place inthe twelfth month of the solar calendar.
solution: 러이 끄라통 축제는 태국 음력으로 12번째 달의 보름달이 뜨 는 날에 열리며, 이는 보통 양력 11월에 해당한다고 언급하고 있으므로 ❺ ‘러이 끄라통 축제는 보통 양력12번째 달에 열린 다.’는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.

body:
Sustainable travel means finding a way that
tourism can (A)[be maintained / maintain] without
harming natural and cultural environments. Travelers
need to be more aware of the pollution caused by
travel and how that affects nature. ⓐ_____________,
they need to be aware of how tourism affects local
people and businesses. The concept of sustainability
has three key factors. First, the environmental factor
focuses on (B)[reduction / reducing] the negative
impact on the natural environment caused by
traveling. This includes minimizing pollution from air
travel, water use, and plastic waste, and not
disturbing wild animals. Second, the social factor is
about the impact on local people. This includes
preserving and supporting communities of local
inhabitants so that they do not suffer from tourism.
Travelers should respect local customs and traditions
and (C)[adjust / adjusting] accordingly, such as by
wearing proper clothes in religious sites. Lastly, the
economic factor is about using money to positively
contribute to the local economy. ⓑ_____________, by
booking a local tour guide or staying in local guest
houses, tourists can support local businesses.

solution: ⓐ 지속가능한 여행을 위해 여행자들은 여행으로 인해 유발되 는 오염과 그것이 자연에 미치는 영향에 대해 더 인식할 필요 가 있다는 내용 뒤에 관광이 현지 사람들과 사업체에 미치는 영향을 인식해야 한다는 추가적인 설명이 이어지고 있으므로 ‘게다가’의 뜻을 가진 In addition 또는 Moreover가 알맞다. ⓑ 지속 가능한 여행을 위한 경제적인 요인은 현지 경제에 긍 정적으로 기여하기 위해 돈을 사용하는 것이라는 내용 뒤에 현지 가이드나 게스트하우스를 이용해 지역을 지원할 수 있다 는 구체적 사례를 들고 있으므로, ‘예를 들어’의 뜻을 가진 For example 또는 For instance가 알맞다.

Sustainable travel means finding a way that
tourism can (A)[be maintained / maintain] without
harming natural and cultural environments. Travelers
need to be more aware of the pollution caused by
travel and how that affects nature. ⓐ_____________,
they need to be aware of how tourism affects local
people and businesses. The concept of sustainability
has three key factors. First, the environmental factor
focuses on (B)[reduction / reducing] the negative
impact on the natural environment caused by
traveling. This includes minimizing pollution from air
travel, water use, and plastic waste, and not
disturbing wild animals. Second, the social factor is
about the impact on local people. This includes
preserving and supporting communities of local
inhabitants so that they do not suffer from tourism.
Travelers should respect local customs and traditions
and (C)[adjust / adjusting] accordingly, such as by
wearing proper clothes in religious sites. Lastly, the
economic factor is about using money to positively
contribute to the local economy. ⓑ_____________, by
booking a local tour guide or staying in local guest
houses, tourists can support local businesses.

In a broad sense, digital art refers to any type of art
ⓐthat is created and displayed with the aid of digital
devices. This artistic format ㉠emerged with the
evolutionary progress in digital media and computers a
few decades ago. In many ways, artworks created with
digital technology sharply ㉡contrast with those ⓑ
made entirely with conventional methods. However, they
are similar ⓒin which digital art also evokes emotional
reactions in viewers. From this perspective, it can be
said that digital art has ㉢shrunk the territory of art.
There ⓓare many types of art that use digital
technology. For instance, music can be recorded and
then changed with the aid of digital devices, or music
can ⓔbe made only with computer software. Some
movies are both created and edited ㉣digitally.
Additionally, art museums ⓕoffering exhibitions displaying
famous paintings of the world on big digital screens.
These examples all ㉤incorporate digital technology
into the creation and display of the work.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

Many of Rockwell’s works about everyday life are
quite (A)[affectionate / apathetic]. An example is
Doctor and the Doll, produced in 1929. The little
girl, who seems to be about four or five years old,
is facing the old man while holding up a doll. The
man is wearing a black suit, and there is a doctor’s
bag under the chair. The girl has already put the
doll’s dress under her arm because she wants to
get her doll examined by the doctor. The doctor is
going along with her wish and is (B)[pretending /
forgetting] to listen to the doll’s heart. He is
treating her and her doll carefully. Doesn’t the look
on her face look like a worried mother at the
hospital? Do you think the girl really thinks the doll
is sick or she is just playing hospital with the
doctor? This work helps us appreciate the
(C)[innocence / ignorance] of children. The girl’s
cuteness and the doctor’s kindness evoke a feeling
of warmth, bringing tender smiles to viewers’ faces.
(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 소녀의 귀여움과 의사의 친절함이 따뜻한 감정을 불러일으키 고 미소를 짓게 하는 1929년에 제작된 '의사와 인형'을 예로 들어 설명하고 있으므로, 일상생활에 관한 Rockwell의 많은 작품들은 꽤 affectionate(다정한) 느낌을 자아내고 있다는 흐름이 알맞다. body:
Welcome everyone to the Norman Rockwell
exhibition. My name is Harris Clark, and I will be
your guide today. Rockwell is one of the most
famous American press ⓐillustrators and painters of
all time. He produced hundreds of covers for
magazines. The main themes of his art include everyday
life, social issues, and his identity as an artist.
Today, we will take a look at the representative
work of each theme. I will help you understand the
world of his art better. Come this way.
Many of Rockwell’s works about everyday life ⓑis
quite tender. An example is Doctor and the Doll,
produced in 1929. The little girl, who seems to be
about four or five years old, is facing the old man
while ⓒholding up a doll. The man is wearing a
black suit, and there is a doctor’s bag under the
chair. The girl ⓓhas already put the doll’s dress
under her arm because she wants to get her doll
examined by the doctor. The doctor is going along
with her wish and is pretending to listen to the
doll’s heart. He is treating her and her doll
carefully. Doesn’t the look on her face look like a
worried mother at the hospital? Do you think the
girl really thinks the doll is sick or she is just
playing hospital with the doctor? This work helps us
ⓔappreciate the innocence of children. The girl’s
cuteness and the doctor’s kindness evoke a feeling
of warmth, bringing tender smiles to viewers’ faces.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution: ⓑ is → are 주어부 ‘Many of Rockwell’s works about everyday life‘의 동 사 자리로, 주어부의 핵은 Rockwell’s works이므로 is를 복수동 사로 수일치 시킨 are로 고친다.

Along the street walks a little African American girl
wearing a pure white dress and (A)[guarded / guarding]

It is segregation and racism in the U.S. This work was
inspired by Ruby Bridges’ historic walk. Ruby was the
first African American child to enter an elementary
school for white children in New Orleans. The U.S.
Supreme Court had just ruled the segregation of public
schools for white and African American students to be
unconstitutional. On her first day of school, she walked
past an angry crowd (C)[was protesting / protesting]
her enrollment at the school for white students. The
historical background made this painting an important
symbol of the Civil Rights Movement in the U.S.

(A)

solution: (A) 장소의 부사구 Along the street가 문두에 와서 주어와 동 사(walks)가 도치를 이루고 있는 완전한 절에 이어지는 분사자 리로, 주어인 ‘a little African American girl’ 을 수식하는 현재분 사 wearing과 등위접속사 and로 연결되는 분사로 주어가 ‘보호 를 받는’의 수동의 관계이므로 과거분사 guarded가 적절하다. (B) Can you guess에 이어지는 간접의문문을 이루는 명사절로, 명사구 contemporary issue와 함께 의문사구를 이뤄야 하므로, 명사구를 수식하는 의문형용사 what이 적절하다. evolutionary progress in digital media and computers

his paintings? When we look at art, it is important
(B)[to grasp / grasp] the artists’ intentions behind it.
Still, it goes without saying (C)[which / that] it is
also important to look at art from various angles

Now, look at The Connoisseur, created in 1962. In
the painting, an abstract art piece is hung on the
wall and a gentleman is looking at it. The man is
painted realistically in Rockwell’s typical style, but the
abstract art piece shows splashes of paint in a variety
of colors. Don’t you think that the abstract art is
quite different from Rockwell’s realistic works? Let me
explain why he painted it. After World War II, art
critics fascinated by abstract art devalued Rockwell’s
realistic style. In response, Rockwell decided to paint
his own abstract painting. He used the drip
technique, which was used by modernist artists at
that time. By combining these different styles in one
art piece, Rockwell highlighted his identity as a
painter as well as an illustrator. In addition, we can
see the man only from the rear. Do you think he
likes or dislikes the abstract painting? Rockwell left
the interpretation of the gentleman’s reaction to us.

윗글의 주제로 알맞은 것은?

the significance of abstract art in contemporaryculture
techniques and trends in modernist artistic movements
the history and impact of The Connoisseur inAmerican art
Rockwell’s exploration of artistic identity in TheConnoisseur

body:
Now, look at The Connoisseur, created in 1962. In
the painting, an abstract art piece is hung on the
wall and a gentleman is looking at it. The man is
painted realistically in Rockwell’s typical style, but
the abstract art piece shows splashes of paint in a
variety of colors. Don’t you think that the abstract
art is quite different from Rockwell’s realistic works?
Let me explain why he painted it. After World War
II, art critics fascinated by abstract art devalued
Rockwell’s realistic style. In response, Rockwell
decided to paint his own abstract painting. He used
the drip technique, which was used by modernist
artists at that time. By combining these different
styles in one art piece, Rockwell highlighted his
identity as a painter as well as an illustrator. In
addition, we can see the man only from the rear.
Do you think he likes or dislikes the abstract
painting? Rockwell left the interpretation of the
gentleman’s reaction to us.

윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: How is the abstract painting depicted in TheConnoisseur?

What is the gentleman’s opinion about the abstractpainting in The Connoisseur?
solution: Rockwell은 ‘감정가’에서 신사가 추상화를 좋아하는지, 싫어하 는지에 대한 반응에 대한 해석의 여지를 보는 사람들에게 남 겨두었다고 언급하고 있으므로 그 신사의 의견은 명확히 알 수 없다. 따라서 ❺ ‘’감정가‘에서의 신사는 추상화에 대해 어 떤 의견을 가지고 있는가?’는 에는 답할 수 없다.

body:
Let’s move on to the next one. Rockwell also
produced works about the social issues of the times
he was living in. Let’s take a look at this piece.
(A) Can you guess what contemporary issue the artist
wanted to describe? It is segregation and racism
in the U.S. This work was inspired by Ruby
Bridges’ historic walk. Ruby was the first African
American child to enter an elementary school
for white children in New Orleans. The U.S.
Supreme Court had just ruled the segregation
of public schools for white and African American
students to be unconstitutional.
(B) On her first day of school, she walked past an
angry crowd protesting her enrollment at the
school for white students. The historical
background made this painting an important
symbol of the Civil Rights Movement in the U.S.
(C) This was painted in 1964. Along the street walks
a little African American girl wearing a pure
white dress and guarded by people wearing
armbands. A tomato, perhaps thrown at her, is
smashed on the ground while juice stains the
wall above. The redness of the tomato easily
captures the viewers’ attention. The title of this
work is The Problem We All Live With.

윗글의 내용과 ⓐ~ⓔ가 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓸 때, 순서대로 연결된 것은?

ⓐ Rockwell addresses the racism Ruby experienced
before attending elementary school. (T/F)
ⓑ The U.S. Supreme Court declared that separating
public schools for white and Black students
violated the Constitution. (T/F)
ⓒ Rockwell’s artwork came to represent a significant
emblem of the U.S. Civil Rights Movement. (T/F)
ⓓ When a little African American girl in a pure
white dress walks down the street, people
wearing armbands throw tomatoes at her. (T/F)
ⓔ A smashed tomato on the ground and its red
juice on the wall failed to catch viewers’ attention.
(T/F)
solution: ⓐ Rockwell은 Ruby가 초등학교에 다니기 전에(→ 초등학교에 입학한 첫 날) 겪었던 인종차별을 다루고 있다. (F) (불일치) ⓑ 미국 대법원은 백인과 흑인 학생들을 위한 공립학교 분리 가 헌법에 위배된다고 선언했다. (T) (일치) ⓒ Rockwell의 그 작품은 미국 시민권 운동의 중요한 상징을 나타내게 되었다. (T) (일치) ⓓ 순백의 드레스를 입은 어린 아프리카계 미국인 소녀가 길 을 걸을 때, 팔에 완장을 찬 사람들이 그녀에게 토마토를 던진 다(→ 그녀를 보호하고 있었다). (F) (불일치) ⓔ 땅에 으깨진 토마토와 벽에 묻은 붉은 주스가 보는 사람들 의 시선을 끌지 못했다(→ 목을 쉽게 사로잡았다). (F) (불일치) 천재(조수경) 2과

In a broad sense, digital art refers to any type of
art that is created and displayed with the aid of
digital devices. This artistic format emerged with the
evolutionary progress in digital media and
computers a few decades ago. In many ways,
artworks created with digital technology sharply
contrast with those made entirely with conventional
methods. However, (A)디지털 아트 역시 관람객들에
게 감정적 반응을 불러일으킨다는 점에서 그들은 비슷
하다. From this perspective, it can be said that
digital art has expanded the territory of art. There
are many types of art that use digital technology.
For instance, music can be recorded and then
changed with the aid of digital devices, or music
can be made only with computer software. Some
movies are both created and edited digitally.
Additionally, art museums offer exhibitions displaying
famous paintings of the world on big digital screens.
These examples all incorporate digital technology
into the creation and display of the work.

Welcome everyone to the Norman Rockwell
exhibition. My name is Harris Clark, and I will be
your guide today. Rockwell is one of the most
famous American press illustrators and painters of
all time. He produced hundreds of covers for
magazines. The main themes of his art (A)[includes
/ include] everyday life, social issues, and his
identity as an artist. Today, we will take a look at
the representative work of each theme. I will help
you (B)[to understand / understanding] the world of
his art better. Come this way.
Many of Rockwell’s works about everyday life are
quite tender. An example is Doctor and the Doll,
produced in 1929. The little girl, who seems to be
about four or five years old, is facing the old man
while holding up a doll. The man is wearing a
black suit, and there is a doctor’s bag under the
chair. The girl has already put the doll’s dress
under her arm because she wants to get her doll
(C)[examined / to exam] by the doctor. The doctor
is going along with her wish and is pretending to
listen to the doll’s heart. He is treating her and her
doll carefully. Doesn’t the look on her face look like
a worried mother at the hospital? Do you think the
girl really thinks the doll is sick or she is just
playing hospital with the doctor? This work ⓐ______
_______________________________________________. The girl’s
cuteness and the doctor’s kindness evoke a feeling
of warmth, bringing tender smiles to viewers’ faces.

What is the general mood conveyed in many ofRockwell’s everyday life paintings?

How does the doctor respond to the little girl’swish?
What specific medical treatment is the doctor givingto the doll?

art that is created and displayed with the aid of
digital devices. This artistic format emerged with the
evolutionary progress in digital media and computers
a few decades ago. In many ways, artworks created
with digital technology sharply contrast with those

expanded the territory of art. There are many types

he was living in. Let’s take a look at this piece.
(A) Can you guess what contemporary issue the artist
wanted to describe? It is segregation and racism
in the U.S. This work was inspired by Ruby
Bridges’ historic walk. Ruby was the first African
American child to enter an elementary school
for white children in New Orleans. The U.S.
Supreme Court had just ruled the segregation
of public schools for white and African American
students to be unconstitutional.
(B) On her first day of school, she walked past an
angry crowd protesting her enrollment at the
school for white students. The historical
background made this painting an important
symbol of the Civil Rights Movement in the U.S.
(C) This was painted in 1964. Along the street walks
a little African American girl wearing a pure
white dress and guarded by people wearing
armbands. A tomato, perhaps thrown at her, is
smashed on the ground while juice stains the
wall above. The redness of the tomato easily
captures the viewers’ attention. The title of this
work is The Problem We All Live With.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: Rockwell이 사회 문제를 다루는 작품을 살펴보자는 주어진 글 다음에, 주어진 글의 this piece를 This로 받으며 작품의 개괄 적인 내용을 설명하며 그 작품의 제목을 언급한 (C), The Problem We All Live With에 서 Rockwell이 다루고자 했던 구 체적인 문제로서 작품 속 소녀인 Ruby Bridges와 미국 사회의 분리와 인종 차별주의를 언급한 (A), 미국 대법원의 인종 차별 에 대한 판결 후 그 소녀에게 일어난 일과 Rockwell의 그림이 미국 시민 인권 운동의 중요한 상징이 되었다고 결론을 짓는 (B)로 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.

Homi, Gardeners’ New Favorite
Search for “Korean homi” on any online platform,
and you can find reviews like these:
Lina: This is the best gardening tool I have ever
had.
Oliver: If you enjoy gardening, this will for sure give
you extra (A)[pleasure / pressure].
Benjamin: Whatever you may expect, ⓐthis is

denouncing] the homi and showing how to use it.
The Korean homi is becoming the hot new tool
gardeners around the world must have. What is a
homi and why is it so popular?
The Korean homi is a traditional farming tool that
has gotten a lot of (C)[criticism / attention], not in
Korea but in countries like the United States and
Australia. In 2019, a video of how to use a homi
spread quickly and widely on the Internet. Suddenly,
the homi had become one of the top selling
gardening tools on the largest online shopping site
in the world.
The homi became so popular because it can be
used for a wide range of gardening tasks. In fact,
people in Europe and the U.S. use separate
gardening tools to weed, dig, and firm the ground.
However, a homi has an ideal shape that ⓑ[makes
/ make] all those activities possible with one tool.
Its thinnest blade is used for weeding, and the
sharp point is used to dig the ground. The flat side
is used to firm the ground.
Next, a homi has a comfortable design. The
Korean homi is usually handmade by blacksmiths.
From decades of experience, they have found the
best angles between the handle and the blade so
that users can tend gardens without pain in their
arms and hands. During the manufacturing process,
a homi is hammered several times by hand, which
makes it stronger and ⓒ[more elaborate / more
elaborately]. This is what differentiates the handmade
Korean homi from gardening tools made by machine.
As you see above, the reputation of Korean
heritage is spreading throughout the world. This

Ondol is a traditional Korean heating system that has been used for thousands of years to warm rooms. It is quite (A)[different from / similar to] the heating systems commonly found in other countries. While most other countries warm their rooms using heating devices in the room, ondol warms the floor and the entire room using heat that is created outside the room. This is made possible through its (B)[ordinary / unique] and scientific structure. A fire is lit in an agungi, which is a kind of stove usually found in traditional Korean kitchens. The hot air then travels through an area, which runs under the room’s floor. On top of the area are flat and wide stones, which are covered with a layer of red mud clay. As the hot air passes through the area under the room’s floor, it heats up the stones. The heated stones (C)[raise / lower] the temperature of the floor, and this warmth spreads and warms the entire room.
solution:
1. (A) 뒤에서 대부분의 나라는 방 안의 난방 장치를 쓰는 반면 온돌은 방 바깥에서 만든 열을 쓴다는 차이를 설명하므로 different from(~와 다른)이 알맞다.
2. (B) 다른 나라와 다른 온돌만의 구조를 설명하는 흐름이므로 unique(독특한)가 알맞다. ordinary는 '평범한'이다.
3. (C) 뜨거운 공기가 돌을 데우고, 데워진 돌이 바닥 온도를 높여 방 전체가 따뜻해지므로 raise(올리다)가 알맞다. lower는 '낮추다'이다.
따라서 답은 ⑤이다.

has been used for thousands of years (A)[to warm /
to warming] rooms. It is quite different from the
heating systems commonly found in other countries.
While most other countries warm their rooms using
heating devices in the room, ondol warms the floor
and the entire room using heat that (B)[creates / is
created] outside the room. This is made possible
through its unique and scientific structure. A fire is
lit in an agungi, which is a kind of stove usually
(C)[found / finding] in traditional Korean kitchens.
The hot air then travels through an area, which
runs under the room’s floor. ⓐ이 구역의 맨 위에는

로 덮여 있다. As the hot air passes through the
area under the room’s floor, it heats up the stones.
The heated stones raise the temperature of the
floor, and this warmth spreads and warms the
entire room.

body:
Hanji, a Rising Star of the Louvre
In Europe, paper is used for the restoration of
cultural assets. For example, paper can be used to
repair the damaged areas of paintings and other
things made of paper. It can also bring new life to
decaying furniture and sculptures by filling in the
cracks.
For such purposes, the Japanese paper called
washi has been widely used. The Louvre Museum in
France was no exception. However, a Korean who
was working at the Louvre in 2014 wanted to let
the world know the value of hanji, traditional
handmade Korean paper.
He convinced the head of the museum’s restoration
team to read his study on the comparison of
traditional papers from Korea and Japan.
After reading his study, the Louvre became
interested in hanji and carried out an experiment to
see whether it would be suitable for use in
restoration. They wet both washi and hanji to
compare their durability. Ultimately, hanji was found
to be more durable than washi. Unlike washi, which
has its fibers lined up in one direction, hanji is
made with both horizontal and vertical fibers. This
means that the fibers in hanji are more closely
woven, making the paper stronger. This also allows
hanji ____________________________________________________.
Because of its durability, hanji was proven to be
excellent material for restoration. Thus, in 2017, the
Louvre used hanji for the first time to restore a
relic from its collection.
Since then, hanji has been used more and more
to restore various cultural assets of the museum.
Who knows? Maybe someday the Mona Lisa, one
of the museum’s most famous paintings, will be
restored with hanji.

윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: to enhance its resilience by absorbing waterrapidly
to enhance its decorative patterns and visualelegance
to alter its form in response to variations inhumidity
to adjust its texture and thickness according toenvironmental changes
to retain its original size and shape better whenits moisture content changes

solution: ‘It’s[It is] certain that ~‘은 ’~라는 것이 확실하다’라는 의미로 확신에 가까운 높은 가능성을 나타낼 때 사용하는 표현이며, 유사한 의미의 표현인 ’I’m sure that ~(나는 ~라는 것을 확신 해)‘, ’It’s clear that ~(~라는 것은 분명해)‘, ’There is no doubt[question] that ~(~라는 것에는 의심의 여지가 없어)‘, ’It’s obvious[evident] that ~(~라는 것은 명백해)‘ 등으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있으나, ’It is unlikely that ~‘은 ’~할 것 같지 않다‘라는 뜻으로 가능성이 낮은 일을 나타내는 표현이므로, 밑줄 친 (A) ‘그것이 어려울 것이라는 것은 확실합니다.’를 ❷ ‘그것은 어려 울 것 같지 않습니다.’로는 바꿔 쓸 수 없다.

body:
The fourth invention is the wireless headset. It was
devised after an unexpected incident NASA had
experienced. The second manned spacecraft launched
by the U.S. completed its mission and successfully
landed in the Atlantic Ocean. The command pilot
was waiting for the recovery team that would get
him and the capsule from the ocean.
Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly,
the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the
cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to
escape, (A)[protecting / abandoning] all of the
spacecraft’s radio communications equipment. This
prevented him from communicating with the recovery
team. He was left floating in the ocean until he
succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter’s
attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner
company developed helmets equipped with a radio
system that could communicate with a designated
base station. Later, wireless headsets using this
system were introduced to the world. These days,
Bluetooth technology has been (B)[incorporated into /
separated from] wireless headsets. Now we can
connect headsets wirelessly with mobile digital
devices such as smartphones and laptops.
In our daily lives, there are many other inventions
that have their origins in space technology including
the smartphone camera and the computer mouse.
Private firms as well as government organizations
have invested heavily in space technology for space
exploration. Therefore, we can expect that our
future lives will be (C)[less / significantly] influenced
by space technology that has not yet been invented.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로바르게 연결된 것은?

(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 구조팀이 도착하기 전에 조종실로 물이 들어와 조종사는 우주선의 통신 장비를 버리고 탈출해야 했고, 회수팀과 연락할 수 없었다는 흐름으로 abandoning(버리면서)이 알맞다. (B) 요즘에는 블루투스 기술이 무선 헤드셋에 통합되어 스마트폰 이나 노트북과 같은 이동형 디지털 장치에 헤드셋을 무선으로 연결 할 수 있다는 흐름으로 incorporated into(~로 통합된)가 알맞다. (C) 정부와 민간 기업 모두 우주 기술에 엄청난 투자를 해 왔기 때 문에, 미래 삶은 아직 발명되지 않은 새로운 우주 기술의 영향을 크게 받을 것이라는 흐름으로 significantly(크게, 상당히)가 알맞다.

Today’s water purifier also originated from space
technology. ⓐWhile planning their human space
exploration program, NASA scientists realized that it
was (A)[impossible / possible] to load a sufficient
amount of clean water into a spacecraft. Then, ⓑthey
hit upon an idea that wastewater could be recycled
once harmful bacteria were removed. So they
developed a water purification system that could
successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to
the invention of a better water purification system
that uses cartridges for longer missions that did not
need to be replaced frequently. This water purifying
technique was developed for several decades and
then marketed for domestic use.
ⓒAnother everyday item developed from space
technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of
food was vital for survival in space. ⓓIn order to get
fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the
spacecraft. However, there was a major obstacle.
When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It
(B)[accelerates / delays] the aging of plants and the
decaying of fruits. ⓔSince it was impossible to
exchange gas for clean air while in space, scientists
developed an air purification system to remove the
gas. Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene,
the system could get rid of other (C)[beneficial /
unwanted] things from the air, too. A private
company recognized the potential of the air
purification system and obtained a license to develop
and commercialize it.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로바르게 연결된 것은?

(A)
(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 해로운 박테리아를 제거하면 폐수를 재활용할 수 있다는 것 을 해결책으로 떠올렸다는 내용이 뒤에 이어지므로, NASA 과학 자들이 우주선에 깨끗한 물을 충분히 싣는 것이 불가능하다는 문제를 깨달았다는 흐름으로 impossible(불가능한)이 알맞다. (B) 신선한 식품을 얻기 위해 우주선에서 작물을 재배해야 했지만 중 대한 장애물이 있었다는 내용 뒤에 이어지는 문제점의 구체적인 내 용으로, 식물이 자랄 때 내뿜는 에틸렌 가스가 식물의 노화와 과일의 부패를 가속화했다는 흐름의 accelerates(가속화 하다)가 알맞다. (C) 한 민간 기업이 공기 정화 시스템의 잠재력을 알아보고 그것 을 개발하고 상업화하기 위해 라이선스를 획득했다는 내용이 이 어지므로, 에틸렌 가스를 없애는 목적 외에 다른 불필요한 물질 도 제거하는 추가적인 기능이 있었다는 흐름으로 unwanted(원치 않은)가 알맞다.

choices: Are you skilled at flying drones?

solution: ‘Are you good at ~?’은 ‘너는 ~을 잘 하니?‘라는 의미로 상대방 에게 무언가를 할 수 있는지를 물을 때 사용하는 표현이며, 능력 유무를 묻는 다른 표현으로 ’Can you ~?(너는 ~을 할 수 있 니?)‘, ’Are you skilled at ~?(너는 ~에 능숙하니?)‘, ’Are you proficient in ~?(너는 ~에 능숙하니?)‘, ’Do you know how to ~?(너는 ~하는 법을 아니?)’ 등이 있으나, ‘Do you have an interest in ~?’은 ‘너는 ~에 관심이 있니?’라는 뜻으로 어떤 것에 대한 상대방의 관심 유무를 묻는 표현이며, 바람이 부는 상황에 서 드론을 조종할 수 있는지를 묻는 대화의 흐름상 어색하다. 따 라서 밑줄 친 (A) ‘너는 드론 조종하는 것을 잘하니?’를 ‘너는 드 론을 조종하는 것에 관심이 있니?’로는 바꿔 쓸 수 없다.

보기 love / recognize / attract (단/

ⓐ
ⓑ

밑줄 친 단어의 영영 풀이로 틀린 것은?
Korea's Heritage Recognized Abroad Korean pop culture is loved all over the world under the name “Korean Wave.” Korean pop music has topped global music charts. Korean films and TV shows attract fans from across the globe. Now, beyond pop culture, the world is starting to pay attention to Korea’s traditional culture. Let’s take a look at some Korean heritage recognized abroad.
choices: attract: to make someone interested in something or cause them to come somewhere
pay attention to: to watch, listen to, or think about something carefully
heritage: a feeling of great surprise and shock
recognize: to know or identify someone or something because you have seen or heard it before
solution: ④의 heritage는 ‘유산, 전통’이라는 뜻으로, 한 나라나 사회에서 오랫동안 이어져 온 문화·역사·전통 등을 의미한다. 하지만 제시된 영영 풀이인 “a feeling of great surprise and shock”는 ‘놀람, 충격’이라는 의미이므로 heritage의 뜻과 맞지 않는다. 반면 나머지는 모두 알맞은 영영 풀이이다. attract: 관심을 끌다 globe: 세계, 지구 pay attention to: 주의를 기울이다 recognize: 알아보다, 인식하다

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
The homi became so popular because it can be used for a wide range of gardening tasks. In fact, people in Europe and the U.S. use separate gardening tools to weed, dig, and firm the ground. However, a homi has an ideal shape that makes all those activities possible with one tool. Its thinnest blade is used for weeding, and the sharp point is used to dig the ground. The flat side is used to firm the ground. Next, a homi has a comfortable design. The Korean homi is usually handmade by blacksmiths. body:
밑줄 친 단어의 영영 풀이로 맞는 것은?
Hanji, a Rising Star of the Louvre In Europe, paper is used for the restoration of cultural assets. For example, paper can be used to repair the damaged areas of paintings and other things made of paper. It can also bring new life to decaying furniture and sculptures by filling in the cracks. For such purposes, the Japanese paper called washi has been widely used. The Louvre Museum in France was no exception. However, a Korean who was working at the Louvre in 2014 wanted to let the world know the value of hanji, traditional handmade Korean paper. He convinced the head of the museum’s restoration team to read his study on the comparison of traditional papers from Korea and Japan. After reading his study, the Louvre became interested in hanji and carried out an experiment to see whether it would be suitable for use in restoration. They wet both washi and hanji to compare their durability. Ultimately, hanji was found to be more durable than washi. Unlike washi, which has its fibers lined up in one direction, hanji is made with both horizontal and vertical fibers. This means that the fibers in hanji are more closely woven, making the paper stronger. This also allows hanji to maintain its original size and shape better when there is a change in its moisture content. Because of its durability, hanji was proven to be excellent material for restoration. Thus, in 2017, the Louvre used hanji for the first time to restore a relic from its collection. Since then, hanji has been used more and more to restore various cultural assets of the museum. Who knows? Maybe someday the Mona Lisa, one of the museum’s most famous paintings, will be restored with hanji.
choices: restoration: a strong feeling of fear and worry
comparison: the act of examining how two or more things are similar or different
durability: the ability to change color easily
horizontal: moving in an up-and-down direction
relic: a modern object made very recently
solution: ②의 comparison은 ‘비교, 대조’라는 뜻으로, 둘 이상의 대상이 어떻게 비슷하거나 다른지를 살펴보는 것을 의미한다. 따라서 “the act of examining how two or more things are similar or different”는 올바른 영영 풀이이다. 반면 나머지는 단어의 실제 의미와 맞지 않는 틀린 풀이이다. restoration → ‘복원, 회복’의 의미인데, 제시된 풀이는 ‘두려움과 걱정’에 관한 설명이다. durability → ‘내구성, 오래 견디는 성질’을 뜻하지만, 제시된 풀이는 ‘쉽게 색이 변하는 능력’이라고 설명하고 있다. horizontal → ‘수평의’라는 뜻인데, 제시된 풀이는 ‘위아래 방향의’라고 하여 반대 의미이다. relic → ‘유물, 유적’의 의미이나, 제시된 풀이는 ‘최근에 만들어진 현대 물건’이라고 설명하고 있다.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?​ In Europe, paper is used for the restoration of cultural assets. For example, paper can be used to repair the damaged areas of paintings and other things made of paper. It can also bring new life to decaying furniture and sculptures by filling in the cracks.
​For such purposes, the Japanese paper called washi has been widely used. The Louvre Museum in France was no exception. However, a Korean who was working at the Louvre in 2014 wanted to let the world know the value of hanji, traditional handmade Korean paper. He convinced the head of the museum’s restoration team to read his study on the comparison of traditional papers from Korea and Japan. ​After reading his study, the Louvre became interested in hanji and carried out an experiment to see whether it would be suitable for use in restoration. They wet both washi and hanji to compare their durability. Ultimately, hanji was found to be more durable than washi. Unlike washi, which has its fibers lined up in one direction, hanji is made with both horizontal and vertical fibers. This means that the fibers in hanji are more closely woven, making the paper stronger. This also allows hanji to maintain its original size and shape better when there is a change in its moisture content. . Thus, in 2017, the Louvre used hanji for the first time to restore a relic from its collection. ​Since then, hanji has been used more and more to restore various cultural assets of the museum. Who knows? Maybe someday the Mona Lisa, one of the museum’s most famous paintings, will be restored with hanji.​
choices: This exceptional resilience made hanji an ideal resource for repairing cultural heritage.
Such unique fiber structures led the museum to exhibit hanji itself as a piece of art.
Consequently, European museums started combining hanji with washi to maximize durability.
This moisture resistance proved that washi was no longer needed for any museum tasks.
Thanks to these qualities, traditional Korean papers completely replaced all restoration tools in France.

다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Ondol is a traditional Korean heating system that has been used for thousands of years to warm rooms. It is quite different from the heating systems commonly found in other countries. While most other countries warm their rooms using heating devices in the room, ondol warms the floor and the entire room using heat that is created outside the room. This is made possible through its unique and scientific structure. A fire is lit in an agungi, which is a kind of stove usually found in traditional Korean kitchens. The hot air then travels through an area, which runs under the room’s floor. On top of the area are flat and wide stones, which are covered with a layer of red mud clay. As the hot air passes through the area under the room’s floor, it heats up the stones. The heated stones raise the temperature of the floor, and this warmth spreads and warms the entire room.
choices: The differences between traditional and modern heating systems
The structural mechanism of the traditional Korean heating system
Various materials used to build traditional Korean houses
The history of kitchen appliances in Korea
The scientific benefits of using red mud clay for health 실전 모의고사 1회차 유형보충독해1

Ondol is a traditional Korean heating system that has been used for thousands of years to warm rooms. It is quite different from the heating systems commonly found in other countries. Rather than inviting the fire directly into the living space, ondol makes the unseen breath of a distant flame embrace the room from below. This is made possible through its unique and scientific structure. A fire is lit in an agungi, which is a kind of stove usually found in traditional Korean kitchens. The hot air then travels through an area, which runs under the room’s floor. On top of the area are flat and wide stones, which are covered with a layer of red mud clay. As the hot air passes through the area under the room’s floor, it heats up the stones. The heated stones raise the temperature of the floor, and this warmth spreads and warms the entire room.
choices: warms the entire room by transferring heat from an outside source through the space under the floor
creates a comfortable atmosphere by hiding the heating devices inside the walls of the room
prevents the heat from escaping the room by sealing the floor with red mud clay
maintains the temperature of the kitchen by trapping the hot air under the cooking stove
replaces the cold air inside the room with the warm smoke produced by the agungi 유형보충독해1
solution: ① 밑줄 친 부분에서 '멀리 있는 불꽃(a distant flame)'은 방 밖의 아궁이에서 피운 불을 의미하고 '보이지 않는 숨결(the unseen breath)'은 바닥 아래 통로로 이동하는 뜨거운 공기 즉 열기를 뜻한다. '아래로부터 방을 품어 안는다(embrace the room from below)'는 바닥을 먼저 데워 방 전체를 따뜻하게 하는 온돌의 핵심 원리를 나타낸다. 따라서 방 외부의 열원(아궁이)에서 발생한 열을 방바닥 아래 공간을 통해 전달하여 방 전체를 데운다는 의미인 ①이 가장 적절하다. ② 난방 장치를 방의 벽 안쪽에 숨겨서 온도를 높인다는 내용은 온돌의 원리(바닥 난방)와 맞지 않는다. ③ 붉은 진흙으로 바닥을 덮어 열이 빠져나가는 것을 막는다는 것은 밑줄 친 부분이 상징하는 난방의 생성 및 전달 원리와 거리가 멀다. ④ 방이 아니라 부엌 조리용 난로 아래에 뜨거운 공기를 가두어 부엌 온도를 유지한다는 내용은 글의 흐름과 전혀 다르다. ⑤ 방 안의 차가운 공기를 아궁이에서 만들어진 연기(smoke) 로 직접 교체한다는 것은 잘못된 설명이다. 연기가 아니라 뜨거운 공기(열기)로 바닥의 돌을 간접적으로 데우는 원리이다.

The Korean homi is a traditional farming tool that has gotten a lot of attention, not in Korea but in countries like the United States and Australia. In 2019, a video of how to use a homi (A)
[spread / disappeared] quickly and widely on the Internet. Suddenly, the homi had become one of the top selling gardening tools on the largest online shopping site in the world. However, a homi has an (B) [optimal / imperfect] shape that makes all those activities possible with one tool. Its thinnest blade is used for weeding, and the sharp point is used to dig the ground. The flat side is used to firm the ground. Next, a homi has a comfortable design. The Korean homi is usually handmade by blacksmiths. From decades of experience, they have found the best angles between the handle and the blade so that users can tend gardens without pain in their arms and hands. During the manufacturing process, a homi is hammered several times by hand, which makes it stronger and more elaborate. This is what (C) [distinguishes / derives] the handmade Korean homi from gardening tools made by machine. 2회차 실전 모의고사

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
After reading his study, the Louvre became interested in hanji and carried out an experiment to see whether it would be suitable for use in restoration. They wet both washi and hanji to compare their durability. Ultimately, 한지가 와시보 다 더 내구성이 있는 것으로 밝혀졌다. Unlike washi, which has its fibers lined up in one direction, hanji is made with both horizontal and vertical fibers. This means that the fibers in hanji are more closely woven, making the paper stronger.
This also allows hanji to maintain its original size and shape better when there is a change in its moisture content. Because of its durability, hanji was proven to be excellent material for restoration. Thus, in 2017, the Louvre used hanji for the first time to restore a relic from its collection. Since then, hanji has been used more and more to restore various cultural assets of the museum. Who knows? Maybe someday the Mona Lisa, one of the museum's most famous paintings, will be restored with hanji.
조건 1. 수동태를 사용할 것
2. (found, to be, more durable, hanji, washi)를 모두 포함할 것
3. 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
→ 2회차 실전 모의고사
answer: hanji was found to be more durable than washi.
solution: ~보다 더 내구성이 있는 것으로 밝혀졌다'는 수동태 구문 'was found to be more durable than'으로 나타낸다. 주어는 'hanji'이고, 수동태 동사구 'was found'를 사용한다. 비교 대상은 'than washi'로 연결한다. 박스에 제공된 'found', 'to be', 'more durable', 'hanji', 'washi'를 정답 형태 그대로 활용하며, 수동태를 구성하는 'was'와 비교급 접속사 'than'은 학생이 직접 추가하여 완성한다.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?​ In Europe, paper is used for the restoration of cultural assets. For example, paper can be used to repair the damaged areas of paintings and other things made of paper. It can also bring new life to decaying furniture and sculptures by filling in the cracks.
For such purposes, the Japanese paper called washi has been widely used. The Louvre Museum in France was no exception. However, a Korean who was working at the Louvre in 2014 wanted to let the world know the value of hanji, traditional handmade Korean paper. He convinced the head of the museum’s restoration team to read his study on the comparison of traditional papers from Korea and Japan. 2회차 실전 모의고사 After reading his study, the Louvre became interested in hanji and carried out an experiment to see whether it would be suitable for use in restoration. They wet both washi and hanji to compare their durability. Ultimately, hanji was found to be more durable than washi. Unlike washi, which has its fibers lined up in one direction, hanji is made with both horizontal and vertical fibers. This means that the fibers in hanji are more closely woven, making the paper stronger. This also allows hanji to maintain its original size and shape better when there is a change in its moisture content. Because of its durability, hanji was proven to be excellent material for restoration. Thus, in 2017, the Louvre used hanji for the first time to restore a relic from its collection.
Since then, hanji has been used more and more to restore various cultural assets of the museum. Who knows? Maybe someday the Mona Lisa, one of the museum’s most famous paintings, will be restored with hanji.
choices: Paper can be used to fix broken furniture by filling cracks.
The Louvre carried out a durability test on hanji and washi.
Washi was proven to be more durable than hanji in the experiment.
The fibers in hanji are closely woven together.
Hanji was used to restore a cultural relic at the Louvre in 2017.

조건 1. 관계대명사 what과 분사를 모두 사용할 것
2. ( this, differentiate, handmade, Korean, homi, from, gardening, tool, machine, by )를 모두 포함할 것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
4. 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
→
answer: This is what differentiates the handmade Korean homi from gardening tools made by machine.
solution: 영작 대상 문장은 'This is what differentiates the handmade Korean homi from gardening tools made by machine.'이다. 먼저, '~하는 것이다'라는 의미를 나타내기 위해 관계대명사 'what'을 사용하여 'This is what ...'의 구조를 만든다. 'what'은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로 명사절을 이끌며, 박스에서 제외되어 있으므로 학생이 직접 써야 한다. 다음으로, '기계로 만든'은 'made by machine'으로 표현하며, 여기서 'made'는 과거분사로 'gardening tools'를 후치 수식하는 분사이다. 박스에서 'machine'과 'by'는 제공되지만 'made'는 제외되어 있으므로 학생이 직접 분사 형태를 써야 한다. 박스 단어의 어형 변형으로는 'differentiate'를 주어 'what절'에 맞게 3인칭 단수 현재형 'differentiates'로, 'tool'을 복수형 'tools'로 변형해야 한다.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
Ondol is a traditional Korean heating system that has been used for thousands of years to warm rooms. It is quite different from the heating systems commonly found in other countries. While most other countries warm their rooms using heating devices in the room, ondol warms the floor and the entire room using heat that is created outside the room. This is made possible through its unique and scientific structure. A fire is lit in an agungi, which is a kind of stove usually found in traditional Korean kitchens. The hot air then travels through an area, which runs under the room’s floor. On top of the area are flat and wide stones, which are covered with a layer of red mud clay. As the hot air passes through the area under the room’s floor, it heats up the stones. The heated stones raise the temperature of the floor, and this warmth spreads and warms the entire room.
choices: Ondol has been utilized to warm rooms for thousands of years.
Most other countries use heating devices located inside the room.
The heat used for ondol is generated outside the room being warmed.
The stones placed under the floor are directly heated by a fire lit on top of them.
The warmth from the heated stones eventually spreads throughout the entire room. 유형보충독해
solution: ④ 아궁이에서 지핀 불로 뜨거워진 공기가 방바닥 아래를 지나가며 돌을 데우는 것이지 바닥 돌 위에서 직접 불을 지피는 것이 아니다. 방 밖에서 만든 열이 바닥 아래로 이동하여 돌을 데운다는 핵심 원리와 다르므로 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는다. ① 온돌이 수천 년 동안 방을 데우는 데 활용되어 왔다는 사실은 글의 첫 번째 문장에서 명확히 확인할 수 있다. ② 서양 등 대부분의 다른 나라들은 방 안에 위치한 별도의 난방 기구를 사용한다는 점이 본문에 명시되어 있다. ③ 온돌 난방에 사용되는 열은 데워지는 방의 외부 즉 아궁이에서 만들어진다는 것을 본문을 통해 알 수 있다. ⑤ 뜨거운 공기를 통해 달궈진 돌에서 나오는 온기가 바닥 온도를 높이고 결국 방 전체로 퍼진다는 내용이 마지막 문장에 정확히 나와 있다.

Benjamin: Whatever you may expect, this is beyond your imagination. Also, there are many videos praising the homi and showing how to use it. The Korean homi is becoming the hot new tool gardeners around the world must have. What is a homi and why is it so popular? The Korean homi is a traditional farming tool that has gotten a lot of attention, not in Korea but in countries like the United States and Australia. In 2019, a video of how to use a homi spread quickly and widely on the Internet. Suddenly, the homi had become one of the top selling gardening tools on the largest online shopping site in the world. The homi became so popular because it can be used for a wide range of gardening tasks. In fact, people in Europe and the U.S. use separate gardening tools to weed, dig, and firm the ground. However, a homi has an ideal shape that makes all those activities possible with one tool. Its thinnest blade is used for weeding, and the sharp point is used to dig the ground. The flat side is used to firm the ground. Next, a homi has a comfortable design. The Korean homi is usually handmade by blacksmiths. From decades of experience, they have found the best angles between the handle and the blade so that users can tend gardens without pain in their arms and hands. During the manufacturing process, a homi is hammered several times by hand, which makes it stronger and more elaborate. This is what differentiates the handmade Korean homi from gardening tools made by machine. As you see above, the reputation of Korean heritage is spreading throughout the world. This proves that the world is discovering its value and potential. What do you think will be the next Korean heritage item that will be recognized abroad?
[요약문] The Korean homi has achieved international fame thanks to its (A) _____ which allows various gardening tasks with a single tool, and its
(B) _____ design crafted by experienced blacksmiths that prevents physical strain.
solution: (A)에는 하나의 도구로 다양한 작업을 가능하게 한다는 내용에 알맞은 '다용도성(versatility)'이 명사 형태로 들어가야 한다. (B)에는 육체적 긴장(통증)을 막아주는 숙련된 대장장이들의 디자인을 설명하는 '편안한(comfortable)'이 형용사 형태로 들어가야 한다. ① versatility (다용도성) - comfortable (편안한) ② versatility (다용도성) - decorative (장식적인) ③ simplicity (단순함) - mass-produced (대량 생산된) ④ restriction (제한성) - comfortable (편안한) ⑤ restriction (제한성) - mass-produced (대량 생산된)

[주어진 문장] However, a homi has an ideal shape that makes all those activities possible with one tool.
solution: 주어진 문장은 'However(그러나)'라는 역접의 연결어로 시작하며, '호미는 하나의 도구로 그 모든 활동들을 가능하게 하는 이상적인 형태를 가졌다'는 내용을 담고 있다. 여기서 지시어 '그 모든 활동들'은 ⓑ의 바로 앞 문장에서 서양 사람들이 각각 분리된 도구를 사용하여 수행하는 작업인 '잡초 뽑기, 땅 파기, 흙 다지기(weed, dig, and firm the ground)'를 가리킨다. 또한, ⓑ의 뒤에 이어지는 문장("Its thinnest blade is used for weeding...")부터는 호미의 각 부분 (얇은 날, 뾰족한 끝, 평평한 면)이 어떻게 하나의 도구로 여러 기능을 수행하는지 구체적으로 설명하고 있다. 따라서 서양의 방식(분리된 도구 사용)과 호미의 장점(하나의 도구로 통합)이 역접으로 연결되고, 바로 뒤에 구체적 부연 설명이 이어지도록 주어진 문장은 ⓑ위치에 들어가는 것이 가장 논리적이다.
